2026-07-24 TERNARY-SELECTIVITY STRATEGY REVISION (research/manuscripts/nr4a3-ternary-selectivity-strategy-revision-2026-07-24.md; folded into STRATEGY.md, which stays authoritative). DIAGNOSIS: the prospective stage sought selectivity ONLY on the MARGINAL axis (an induced-interface free-energy difference). selectivity_margin_model.py: an 80%/20% degradation window needs ~2.0 kcal/mol of TRUE margin (median over 27 potency scenarios, 1.75-2.25) vs a best-case RESOLVABLE difference of 1.12 kcal/mol (replicate SD 0.7, n=3) [SUPERSEDED: 0.60 kcal/mol on the MEASURED replicate SD 0.375, beside a MEASURED 1.543 kcal/mol wrong-sign accuracy - the axis is UNCALIBRATED, not near its resolution limit] and ~1.7 kcal/mol RMSE accuracy that does not even cover the NAGL ternary lane -> that axis is a CONFIRMATION tool at its limit, not a DISCOVERY tool. FIX: search CATEGORICAL axes first, where the paralogues are structurally incapable. nr4a_paralogue_unique_residues.py (full-length UniProt, dual-aligner agreement, run on CI): NR4A3 has 4 unique cysteines (C397 RSA 0.395 at 10.9 A from the cryptic pocket = exit-vector reach; C420; C559; C166 outside the LBD) and 4 unique lysines (K572 RSA 0.879, K518, K592 exposed at 11-16 A; K178 outside) that BOTH paralogues lack. At ZERO thermodynamic margin those give 0.82 (unique lysine) / 0.92 (covalent capture, kinetic form) on the window metric where the interface-only null gives 0.185. PRECEDENT: NR-V04, the field's one demonstrated NR4A-family-selective degrader, is most parsimoniously explained by a paralogue-unique cysteine (NR4A1 C551 -> NR4A3 T579, reproduced here) - filed until now only as a confound. CHECKED-AND-WEAK, reported not dropped: the EWSR1 fusion moiety contributes only 1-2 lysines (Lys-poor LC domain) -> fusion-lysine axis is thin, NOT a design axis. SIX COST LEVERS: (1) 4 fs ternary production ~2x cheaper/leg (runbook 1c: post-pre-equilibration calib ran production 40/40 at 4 fs, zero NaN; iterations are timestep-independent) - PROPOSED, settled by one ~$5-8 matched re-calibration edge; (2) the binary and solvent legs are PARALOGUE-INDEPENDENT so they cancel EXACTLY in any paralogue comparison -> a 3-paralogue panel is 3 ternary LEGS + 1 shared binary + 1 shared solvent, NOT 3 edges (valB_full module 3 and nrv04_retrospective were both priced as N edges); (3) sequential anytime-valid stopping via the already-built adaptive_certify.py, ~20-25%; (4) decouple the causal kill-switch from valB_full + nrv04_retrospective so the free gates lead; (5) the LIGAND-SIDE DOUBLE DIFFERENCE S = ddG_coop(d0->d|NR4A3) - ddG_coop(d0->d|NR4A1) becomes the PRIMARY causal test (ternary legs only, no protein-mutation engine, no cross-lane charge mismatch); the protein-mutation cycle is kept as a CONFIRMATORY second line, still UNPRICED; (6) E3 breadth is free at CPU search, capped at <=2 recruiters before any GPU. Ladder at the time: ~$390 mid -> ~$240 mid; SUPERSEDED - the economics of record are the 2026-07-25 note above (~$194 mid, ~$47-561), and the EXPECTED cost is lower still because the leading gates are $0. THE THREE DECISIONS THIS REVISION RAISED ARE ALL NOW DECIDED (trimcrae go, 2026-07-24): adopt 4 fs (TWO-STAGE - a ~$1-2 survival probe first, then the matched re-calibration edge, sequenced after valB_mini's 2 fs result); swap the method calibrator to SMARCA2-vs-SMARCA4 (NR-V04 stays the biological holdout); demote the protein-mutation wedge to confirmatory. Lever 1's '~$5-8 matched re-calibration edge' is repriced to ~$4.4 ($1.6-11), and lever 5's 'still UNPRICED' confirmatory line is now a QUALIFIED engine with a ~$4.6 PROJECTED cost (see the 2026-07-25 economics note).

milestones.result: DONE 2026-07-30, $0, AND IT REFUTED ITS OWN PREMISE. Diagnostic: linker_branch_reach.py -> linker-branch-reach.json, 7 tests, re-enumerates nothing. THE BLOCKER IS THE CHAIN TEMPLATE, NOT THE GRID: build_smiles takes ONE `pendant` and its template has a single branch residue, so no choice of segments, length or placement can emit a two-mechanism molecule -- every sweep over the grid was searching a space that structurally cannot contain the answer. The committed enumeration refutes the rest of the old reason directly: it builds T407 branches at n=16 AND C397 branches at n=16, i.e. both targets at three shared lengths (16, 18, 20), and NO recorded T407 window is k in [2,3] -- the real ones are k in [2,6] and k in [4,13] and the enumerator builds inside them. The branch floor k = 3 + SEG2 + tail is real, is independent of SEG1 and of chain length, and is ARCHITECTURAL (the 3 is the branch residue's own N-Calpha-C; SEG2 = 0 is refused as an acylurea), so no grid change reaches k < 4. WHAT WOULD WORK: a TWO-BRANCH template, constructible at n = 18 with the segments the grid already has -- no new chemistry. NOT TAKEN HERE: that is a DESIGN change to a preregistered enumeration, not a defect fix, so it does not qualify under the amendment standard and needs an explicit decision. The existing library is untouched and nothing in it is invalidated.
milestones.superseded_why: SUPERSEDED, retained: On the crbn|M0 placement the covalent series sits at 14 backbone atoms and the wedge pair at 19; a single chain carrying BOTH needs 16, and the segment grid cannot build it (branch floor k=6 against T407's k in [2,3] at n=16). That is a property of the ENUMERATOR's grid, not of the geometry -- so the design that would carry the categorical handle and the causal wedge on one molecule is currently unreachable for a reason that has nothing to do with chemistry.
milestones.no_go_reading_outcome: HALF-FIRED, and the honest report is the half that did. The reading said: if no admissible branch exists either, the limit IS geometric and that is the finding. One exists in principle; what does not exist is a template to hold it. So the paper's statement is neither 'a grid limit' nor 'geometry' -- it is that the enumerated ARCHITECTURE carries one mechanism per molecule, a real constraint on the design as enumerated.
